Subject: Private deployment cutover plan: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on‑prem package

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a pragmatic cutover sequence for AstraThera's private deployment so we can minimize app downtime and meet your security gating. Attached is a one‑page checklist and a high‑level network map. Key items I want to highlight: 

- VPC peering / Transit: coordinate CIDR ranges and routing stub (we need your routable CIDR and the transit account ID).
- Private endpoints: we recommend 2 endpoints (in prod AZs) with internal DNS entries; we will provide a Terraform snippet.
- On‑prem appliance: estimated 4 hours for install + 2 hours validation window; ask: please confirm a host with internet egress for initial bootstrap.
- Audit & logs: retention policy and log sink details (we support pushing to your S3 bucket or a partner SIEM).

Next steps / asks from you:
1) Confirm routable CIDR(s) and transit account ID by Friday 10/8.
2) Share a contact for procurement so we can start the SOW thread (I attached the SOW draft for reference).
3) Let us know if you have a preferred change window (nights/weekend) for cutover.

I've cc'd Monica and Grace from our implementation team — Monica will be your primary CS engineer and will run the VPC peering workstream.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Sean — this looks actionable, appreciate the clarity. A few quick items from our side: 

- CIDRs: we can provision 10.40.0.0/16 for the Redwood peering; our transit account is 111222333444.
- Change window: prefer a Saturday morning slot (UTC 15:00-19:00 is our current maintenance window).
- On‑prem appliance: we have an infra host ready (jumpbox) but will need the detailed bootstrap steps.

Questions: 
1) For the private endpoints, do you support SRV records or only A records?
2) Do we need any specific firewall rules outbound from our VPC to the appliance for initial registration?

I'll loop in Kyle (external security consultant) if needed for the audit details.

--

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-04T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment cutover plan: VPC peering, private endpoints, and on‑prem package

Sean / Grace — forwarding Elena's reply so we can schedule the work. Quick notes from my side after reading: 

- SRV records: Redwood's internal resolver supports CNAME/A; we can add SRV if AstraThera's DNS provider supports the service discovery pattern. If they need SRV we will provide the template but ask for the authoritative DNS engineer.
- Firewall rules: open outbound TCP 443 to our bootstrap endpoint (we'll give a short‑lived hostname during install) plus outbound to 169.254.169.254 is not required.
- CIDR overlap check: I will run a dry‑run routing validation against the provided 10.40.0.0/16.

Proposed internal cadence:
- Wed 10/06: provisioning scripts + Terraform snippet ready, send to Elena.
- Fri 10/08: alignment call to confirm SOW and change window.
- Sat 10/10 (maintenance): cutover attempt (monitoring for 2 hours).

I'll attach the Terraform snippet and a short validation checklist to the Fri alignment email.

Monica Patel
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Elena / Marcus — short update and attached artifacts (Terraform snippet + validation checklist). Action items we've completed: 
- CIDR overlap check: Monica ran validation — no overlap found for 10.40.0.0/16.
- Terraform snippet: includes aws_vpc_peering_connection, route additions, and example private endpoint module.
- SOW: updated to reflect the Saturday cutover and 2‑hour monitoring SLA post-cutover.

Please review the attached checklist prior to the Fri 10/08 alignment call. On the call we'll: 
1) Lock the final change window and escalation contacts.
2) Walk the bootstrap steps for the on‑prem appliance (we'll need SSH access to the jumpbox during the window).

If you prefer, we can run a dry‑run in staging on Friday morning before the weekend window.

Thanks —
Sean
